text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To face it with such resolve,
only for it to end like this...?
choice_data_list: I apologize for being unable to be of help...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Both the training regime and the race tactics were ultimately approved by me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we may have stumbled.
However—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Then we need only rise again.
For we now possess a new seed called "failure."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Will you bear witness?
To my challenge renewed, as I strive to build a garden of victory for the future.
choice_data_list: Of course. Allow me to take a look.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If we lose even our fighting spirit,
nothing that could be achieved will ever come to pass.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though the path ahead may be fraught with hardship,
I hope you will remain by my side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: For the sake of a glorious future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, watch over me.
Though I have never once imagined a future where you were not by my side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is only through the strength of those who support us
that the Rose Clan can pursue its lifelong dream.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My clan has always walked hand in hand
with defeat. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
They shall not wither.
The roses—never.
